'''Japet Saun''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who betrayed [[Scarlet Hark]] to [[Baasen Ray]] on [[Cioran]]. He had a girlfriend named [[Aminni]]. He was visited by Han Solo to be interrogated on how and why he betrayed Scarlet, and her current location.
